newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia M2 seen rising 18 percent in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia M2 seen rising 18 percent in 1997/98.

text.p: Indonesia's broad M2 money supply is forecast to rise 18 percent to 323.6 trillion rupiah in fiscal 1997/98, the Finance Ministry said.
In a briefing ahead of President Suharto's 1997/98 (April-March), budget speech to parliament on Monday, the ministry said narrow M1 money was expected to rise 16 percent to 71.55 trillion rupiah.
Year-on-year M2 growth in November was 28 percent and M1 was 19 percent, central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono told reporters.
The planned growth rate of M2 for fiscal 1996/97 was 17 percent.
